{{Quote|If Shai Tenna's not cracking the whip, we've got no call to fight you. The White Maw cut us loose.|Karhei|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Karhei''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang during the [[Galactic War]]. After his boss [[Shai Tenna]] attempted a failed coup against White Maw [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] leaders and perished at the hand of the [[Voidhound]], Karhei and other Tenna's men could not return to the White Maw and so set up to work for the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] instead.
